name: Herodias
bio: Herodias, wife of Philip and then of his brother Herod the tetrarch (Herod Antipas), wanted John the Baptist killed after he condemned her marriage. At a banquet, she instructed her dancing daughter to ask Herod for John's head on a platter, and Herod, bound by a rash oath, had John beheaded (Matthew 14:3-11).
